verdict.rationale: Cursor's docs show Cloud Agents supporting multi-repo environments: one agent can inspect the full workspace, make coordinated changes across repos, and accept up to 20 repos per agent via the API. That gives one session context across multiple projects, but only in the cloud-agent surface. Missing for 10: evidence of multi-root or multiple local project directories in the IDE or CLI session, details on how cross-repo context is indexed, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can include multiple project directories in a single session for broader context

citations.quote: inspect the full workspace, make coordinated changes, and open pull requests in the repos it changes
